name: SK_ID_PREV
details: ID of previous credit in Home credit related to loan in our sample. (One loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more previous loans in Home Credit) [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: SK_ID_CURR
details: ID of loan in our sample [Metadata note: hashed.]

name: MONTHS_BALANCE
details: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the freshest balance date) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: AMT_BALANCE
details: Balance during the month of previous credit

name: AMT_CREDIT_LIMIT_ACTUAL
details: Credit card limit during the month of the previous credit

name: AMT_DRAWINGS_ATM_CURRENT
details: Amount drawing at ATM during the month of the previous credit

name: AMT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT
details: Amount drawing during the month of the previous credit

name: AMT_DRAWINGS_OTHER_CURRENT
details: Amount of other drawings during the month of the previous credit

name: AMT_DRAWINGS_POS_CURRENT
details: Amount drawing or buying goods during the month of the previous credit

name: AMT_INST_MIN_REGULARITY
details: Minimal installment for this month of the previous credit

name: AMT_PAYMENT_CURRENT
details: How much did the client pay during the month on the previous credit

name: AMT_PAYMENT_TOTAL_CURRENT
details: How much did the client pay during the month in total on the previous credit

name: AMT_RECEIVABLE_PRINCIPAL
details: Amount receivable for principal on the previous credit

name: AMT_RECIVABLE
details: Amount receivable on the previous credit

name: AMT_TOTAL_RECEIVABLE
details: Total amount receivable on the previous credit

name: CNT_DRAWINGS_ATM_CURRENT
details: Number of drawings at ATM during this month on the previous credit

name: CNT_DRAWINGS_CURRENT
details: Number of drawings during this month on the previous credit

name: CNT_DRAWINGS_OTHER_CURRENT
details: Number of other drawings during this month on the previous credit

name: CNT_DRAWINGS_POS_CURRENT
details: Number of drawings for goods during this month on the previous credit

name: CNT_INSTALMENT_MATURE_CUM
details: Number of paid installments on the previous credit

name: NAME_CONTRACT_STATUS
details: Contract status (active signed,...) on the previous credit

name: SK_DPD
details: DPD (Days past due) during the month on the previous credit

name: SK_DPD_DEF
details: DPD (Days past due) during the month with tolerance (debts with low loan amounts are ignored) of the previous credit
